audience: asset and IT managers who track equipment and locations in Asset Panda

useCases.title: See how an account is organized
useCases.text: List the accounts, modules, collections and columns. Use the column ids to build a search filter for the records you need.

useCases.title: Find all assets in one location
useCases.text: Search the records of a collection with a filter on the location column. Open one record to read all of its fields.

useCases.title: Move assets to a new location
useCases.text: Search for the assets in the old location. Then update the location column of those records in one batch.

useCases.title: Add new equipment records
useCases.text: Create new records in a collection from a list of items. Each record maps column ids to values.
